full_prompt_en: A square watercolor-and-ink storybook illustration shows a small child crouching on a snowy stone doorstep face to face with a gray-brown mouse. The old green wooden door fills most of the upper background. Its inset panels are weathered with darker grain, and a small round knob sits high at the left. Narrow sections of red brick and rough pale stone frame the door on both sides. The child occupies the right half, balanced low on bent legs and leaning forward with hands tucked near the knees. A bright orange knit cap covers much of the curly brown hair, and an orange coat with a muted green hood gathers around the shoulders. Blue trousers fold over sturdy tan lace-up boots whose dark soles rest on the uneven top step. The face is shown in profile, close enough to the mouse for their noses to nearly align. At the left of the doorway, the little mouse perches on the narrow inner threshold. Its rounded gray-tan body, pink ear, small dark eye, pointed snout, and long thin tail are clearly visible; the tail hangs over the lower stone riser. Large gray stone steps fill the lower half, each block outlined with irregular dark ink and softened by watercolor shading. White snow collects along the bottom edge and in gaps around the stones, making the warm clothing stand out. A small pale scrap sits near the middle step, but no other objects crowd the meeting. Light is diffuse and wintry, coming from the open front and upper left; soft highlights touch the cap, mouse, and stone edges, while the doorway recess stays darker. Loose green, gray, and ocher washes show through the scratchy line work, leaving visible paper texture. No readable text appears. The overall composition is intimate and gently humorous, using the paired profiles and rough winter setting to focus attention on a quiet moment of curiosity.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩与墨线故事书插画呈现一个小孩蹲在积雪石门阶上，与一只灰褐色老鼠面对面。旧绿木门占据大部分上部背景。嵌板带有更深木纹和风化痕迹，小小圆门把位于左侧高处。红砖和粗糙浅色石料的窄条在两侧框住门。孩子占据右半部，双腿弯曲低低蹲着，身体前倾，双手收在膝边。明亮橙色针织帽盖住大部分棕色卷发，带低调绿帽兜的橙色外套聚在肩上。蓝色长裤折叠到结实的黄褐色系带靴上，深色鞋底踏在参差的最上层石阶。脸以侧面出现，与老鼠靠得很近，两只鼻子几乎对齐。门口左侧，小老鼠停在狭窄内部门槛上。圆润灰棕色身体、粉色耳朵、小深色眼睛、尖口鼻和细长尾巴清楚可见；尾巴垂过下方石阶立面。大块灰石阶填满下半部，每块石头由不规则深墨线勾勒，并经水彩阴影柔化。白雪聚于底缘和石块缝隙，让暖色衣服更加醒目。中间台阶附近有一小片浅色碎屑，但没有其他物件挤满相遇之处。光从开放的前方和左上方漫射而来，带着冬日气息；柔和高光落在帽子、老鼠和石阶边缘，门洞凹处仍较暗。松散的绿色、灰色与赭色水彩从粗糙线条间透出，保留可见纸面肌理。画中没有可读文字。整体构图亲近而温柔有趣，借相对的两个侧脸和粗糙冬日环境，把注意力放在安静的好奇一刻。
style_prompt_en: The storybook image combines lively dark ink contours with translucent watercolor washes and visible paper grain. Muted sage green, stone gray, tan, and cream occupy broad areas, while a compact orange accent draws attention into the center of the action. Outlines wobble with hand-drawn irregularity and become broken or lighter inside textured surfaces. Large blocky forms provide a stable base, while tiny rounded details and fine curved lines introduce tenderness. Diffuse pale light softens cast shadows, letting recesses deepen through layered gray-green wash rather than hard black fill. Pigment pools and dry-brush speckles make the surfaces look worn and tactile. Close spacing between two small focal shapes contrasts with quieter surrounding planes. The overall effect is warm despite the cool palette, with gentle narrative energy carried by the loose line and selective color.
style_prompt_zh: 故事书图像把生动深墨轮廓与透明水彩色洗、可见纸面颗粒结合。低调鼠尾草绿、石灰、黄褐与奶油色占据宽阔区域，一处紧凑橙色重音把注意力引向动作中心。轮廓带手绘般摇晃的不规则性，在有肌理的表面内部变得断续或浅淡。大块方整形态提供稳定底座，细小圆润细节与纤细曲线则添入温柔。浅淡漫射光柔化投影，使凹处通过层层灰绿色水洗加深，而非坚硬黑色填充。颜料积聚与干笔斑点让表面显得磨旧而可触。两个小焦点形体之间的靠近，对照周围更安静的色面。整体效果虽用冷色域仍然温暖，温柔的叙事能量由松散线条和有选择的色彩承载。
theme_en: A child crouching to meet a small mouse on a snowy doorstep
theme_zh: 孩子在积雪门阶前蹲下，与小老鼠相遇
name: Robert Munsch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
